items.title: Tom McIntosh — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Eric Jackson is identified as the interviewer in the metadata and transcript headers, but no personal or professional relationship between Tom McIntosh and Eric Jackson is described in the text.

ctx.x: Interviewer: Eric Jackson with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 57 pp.
Today is Friday December 9th. We are talking to Tom “Mac” McIntosh. Tom, let’s begin at the beginning. You were born in Baltimore December 6th 1927?
